name: DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale

lifecycle.note: Weights are still public on DeepSeek's Hugging Face organisation under the MIT License. Its API access ran only on a temporary endpoint until 2025-12-15 15:59 UTC.

relations.note: DeepSeek calls it a high-compute, experimental variant of DeepSeek-V3.2.

summary.text: DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale is a high-compute variant of DeepSeek-V3.2 designed for deep reasoning tasks, announced with it on 1 December 2025 and released with open weights under the MIT License. It does not support tool calling, and at launch it was offered only through a temporary API endpoint until 15 December 2025.

changes.text: Trained only on reasoning data with a reduced length penalty in reinforcement learning, plus the DeepSeekMath-V2 dataset and reward method for mathematical proofs.
Offered only through a temporary API endpoint until 15 December 2025, not in the DeepSeek app or web chat.

openWeights.note: MIT License for the repository and the weights.

access.note: API-only at launch (not in the app or web chat), through a temporary endpoint without tool calls that ran until 2025-12-15.

notes: Announced together with DeepSeek-V3.2. The model card says DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale has the same model structure as DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp and does not support tool calling; parameters and context window are not restated for it, so they are left out. The Hugging Face repository was created on 2025-11-28, which no DeepSeek page states in text. No dedicated API model name was given; it was reached through the base_url https://api.deepseek.com/v3.2_speciale_expires_on_20251215.
